patch.value: Phase 3: distribution over a real transport

Bundles let two repositories exchange history offline, which is enough to prove the object model but is not distribution. This phase adds named remotes, remote-tracking refs, and clone, fetch and push over a transport, with object negotiation computed from reachability rather than sending the whole store, and non-fast-forward pushes refused by default.

pm vcs clone produces a repository whose object closure and refs are identical to the source; fetch transfers only objects the receiver lacks; push refuses a non-fast-forward without an explicit override and never leaves a ref pointing at an object that was not transferred; remote-tracking refs live under refs/remotes and are never confused with local branches
